comments.author: DoctorDaddy
comments.body_html: Hey sorry, are the default settings in the mod config essentially set to vanilla Tarkov? I really just want to use this mod to make healing items have more MaxHpPool, but don’t necessarily want the other changes. Is that possible with this mod?

comments.author: McOnie
comments.body_html:
Unfortunately the setting were arbitrarily set for each of the items, so if you enable them it will affect all aspects of the item and not just to the MaxHpPool. What you can do is delete all of the additional options in the config file except the MaxHpPool and enable. It will throw a warning in the server, but the mod logic is built to handle if there is a missing value.

I hope that makes sense, and let me know if you have any problems. I would recommend backing up your profile as although it shouldn’t affect it, what I’m suggesting isn’t the usual use case.
